message: 年齢だけは追いつけない

name: Synn
message: 「...Is it this late already?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey... Lolotte... If you fall asleep now, you'll definitely... die...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Dead men tell no tales, ya know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way... If I fall asleep like this, it'll be tomorrow before I know it...」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone~~ I brought some super bitter tea to wake you up~\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll take some!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thank you very much. Though if it's green tea, Misa will--」

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like... she didn't need any\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it's tea Ria brewed, I can down as many cups as you've got!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uwaaaah!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Maybe Russian roulette green tea was going a little too far」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you put in it...」

name: Ria
message: 「That's a secret♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So bitter!! Another cup!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gulp, gulp... Phew--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, wide awake!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Congrats~~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, everyone else is...」

name: Ria
message: 「We still have tomorrow, so I think if you're going to sleep, you should get some proper rest...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, who could that be?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave picking up and dropping off the young lady to me, Riesling Toyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, were you waiting until we finished?」

name: Riesling
message: 「No, I was just doing a bit of weeding.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why would you do that? I'm really sorry.」
And so, after having her take Misa home with her, the three of us--Nanaka, Ria-senpai, and I--resumed studying.

name: Ria
message: 「Don't push yourselves too hard either, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're fine. It's not like we're pulling an all-nighter yet.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not yet... It ain't over yet...」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan, you look super sleepy, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「--Gah?! Y-You're one to talk, Ria-senpai!! Shouldn't you be taking it easy too?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Me? I'm totally fine.」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, I'm everyone's guardian. I have to keep watch so nobody pushes themselves until they collapse.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr... She's flexing her senpai authority on me... At this rate, I'm gonna get blown away」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. If you're sleepy, you can go to bed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gyaah!! You have no idea how I feel, you jerk!」

name: Sally
message: 「Pre~~~z. I'm hungr~~~y」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's about time for dinner...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gyaah!! Now even Sally-chan joined in!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on, dinner...?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eat dinner → get full → Sally-chan exits → Ria-senpai goes straight to sleep」

name: Nanaka
message: 「→ And then I'm happily alone with Synn?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's iiiiit!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a brilliant strategy that satisfies both my stomach and my heart」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um... Nanaka-chan?」

name: Sally
message: 「Didn't she study so hard that she turned into an idiot?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone! I'm gonna go make some soba, so hang tight for a bit!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, I'll help--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No need, no need! I'm gonna treat you to a huge feast, so work up a big appetite and wait up!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, I'll be waiting~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「What's with all that energy」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~. Maybe she'll fall asleep if she doesn't keep moving」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa! An earthquake!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-She's really putting her spirit into it」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan... If she works that hard, won't she just get tired and sleepy instead...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew~!! Thanks for waiting!」

name: Synn
message: 「You've worked up quite a sweat, Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, of course. After all, today is Synn's birth--」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun's...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-B-Boy... whoops. Boy, are we gonna see some seconds!!」

name: Synn
message: 「My seconds...?」
Something's weird. Even though she always serves me just enough that I'm right on the edge of not asking for seconds.

name: Sally
message: 「Thank you for the food!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eat up plenty too, Ria-senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're plotting something, aren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-N-No, nothing of the sort!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Isn't she trying to fatten Ria up?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I'd ever do that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine, Ria-senpai. Soba is even effective for dieting! Probably」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah... thanks for the food~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haa, haa, good, good... Now I just need to get her to eat a bunch...」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's spicy!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Sally
message: 「I put wasabi in it」

name: Ria
message: 「Uuuuh\s06」

name: Sally
message: 「You're pulling an all-nighter to work hard, right? So I figured it'd wake you up」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a great idea. Or at least, that's what I'd like to say, but--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrrr! What did you do, you little devil!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eh, ah, oh no. Nanaka, are you mad?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course I'm maaaaaad!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eeeeek!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure are energetic...」
Actually, why is Nanaka the one getting mad when Ria-senpai is the one suffering?
Geez, Nanaka really is too kind.

name: Ria
message: 「Sniff... sniffle」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay, Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm totally fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you'll be able to keep pushing through after this, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm so jealous of Nanaka」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「She gets to cheer you up like this, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, we've known each other for a long time, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「I might... get a little jealous♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--!? N-Nanaka and I aren't like that! We're just childhood friends」

name: Ria
message: 「I wish there were something I could do for you too」

name: Synn
message: 「You always cheer me up too, Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Really...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like how you're helping me study today, for instance」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that all?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, besides that...」

name: Ria
message: 「What is it? What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-There are too many to list, I don't know where to start\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Or maybe you just couldn't think of anything」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true at all!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe, it's okay. You don't have to force yourself」
For some reason, I felt like naming them would push Ria-senpai further away, so I couldn't say anything.
Even though I'm always the one getting cheered up by Ria-senpai without ever giving anything back.

name: Synn
message: 「Just having you by my side makes me feel relieved, or comforted, I guess...」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But still! Relying on you all the time is... well...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehehe. It's okay to let me spoil you more, Synn\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Then again, you are a boy, Synn. Hearing something like that probably doesn't make you very happy」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's right」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. Sorry...」
Ugh... Why can't I just be honest in front of Ria-senpai?
That's probably because--

name: Sally
message: 「Uwee... That was awful」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Welcome back. Where's Nanaka?」

name: Sally
message: 「Looks like she's wiped out. She's fast asleep in the entryway」

name: Synn
message: 「In the entryway!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, after running around that much, I'm not surprised. Hup」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa, Synn-kun... You're so strong~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, this much is nothing...」
I wonder if I'd actually be able to give Ria-senpai a piggyback ride...
Wait, no, no! That's basically saying Ria-senpai is heavier than Nanaka.
Then I lay out a futon in an empty room, put Nanaka to bed, and go back to studying.
Did Sally-chan set off on another wandering journey somewhere?

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai. It's getting pretty late, though... Are you sure you're okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. I'm fine」

name: Synn
message: 「But won't your family worry if you get home late?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's fine, it's fine. I told them I was going to Synn-kun's house, after all. My big sister will cover for me」
I'm not sure whether to feel happy or sad about that.

name: Ria
message: 「More importantly, I can't just leave Nanaka-chan behind and go home」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not?」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Because... leaving a teenage boy and girl alone under the same roof...」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well...」

name: Ria
message: 「Your senpai is going to keep a close eye on you, so I won't let you do anything weird!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't do anything weird! Nanaka's slept over here tons of times before!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... right. You're childhood friends, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't call it worrying--you're just reading way too much into things」

name: Synn
message: 「Or are you the type of person who immediately jumps to doing stuff like that the second we're alone, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez! I wouldn't do anything like that!」
Good grief... She acts all mature like an upperclassman, yet she's completely hopeless with topics like this.
Well, I'm not exactly great with them either, so I want to clear this awkward air as fast as possible.

name: Ria
message: 「Eek」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, nice timing」

name: Synn
message: 「A letter from Dad, maybe」

name: Ria
message: 「A-A bat...?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a messenger bat. Let's see here--」

name: Synn
message: 「Happy... birthday?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... Synn-kun. Today's your birthday?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, it seems... so」

name: Ria
message: 「Why didn't you tell me!」

name: Synn
message: 「I completely forgot! My head was so full of Student Council stuff and tests...」
Even before that, bringing it up myself would've been way too embarrassing.

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Mom and Dad actually remembered, huh...」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, Synn-kun. I'm sorry. If I'd known--」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! It's totally fine!」

name: Ria
message: 「No way! It's not too late yet, so I'm going out to buy you a present!」

name: Synn
message: 「You really don't have to do that!」

name: Ria
message: 「No buts! Synn-kun, you be a good boy and stay home studying while you wait!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, come on!」
The moment I reached out to grab the stubborn Ria-senpai's arm――

name: Synn
message: 「Ah.」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyah!」
A soft, bouncy sensation filled my palm.
I had ended up grabbing a handful of her huge breasts!

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorr――」
Perhaps because I was panicking, I tripped over Paqy, who was lying flat on the ground.

name: Paqy
message: 「Apepi!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sh-Synn-kun! Hang in there!!」
Ah, my head is resting on a warm, soft pillow...
And it smells so good, too...

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, thank goodness♪」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry. I guess I got a little carried away...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm the one who... um, touched your chest, Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Ah! About that... That was an accident, right?」
So this is kind Ria-senpai's lap...
No wonder it feels so nice.

name: Ria
message: 「Still, your birthday only comes once a year, right? It's sad if nobody celebrates it with you.」
For some reason, I couldn't bring myself to tell Ria-senpai that Nanaka had always celebrated it with me up until last year.

name: Ria
message: 「So I thought, at the very least, if I could celebrate it for you...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai, about my birthday present...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hm?」

name: Synn
message: 「Would it be okay if I just... slept like this on your lap for a little while?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-If not, that's totally fine!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. You're such a spoiled baby, Synn-kun\s04」
Saying that, Ria-senpai gently stroked my head.

name: Ria
message: 「Just for a little while, okay?♪」
Combined with my fatigue from studying, the comfort of her thighs made my whole body melt.
By the way, it's a secret that Ria-senpai's chest is in the way, so I can't really see her face.

name: Ria
message: 「Once you rest a bit, it's back to studying, alright?\s07」
I get so much energy from my gentle yet strict senpai.
